CustomField.description: Grouping for Board Report YOY Quarter based on Board_Report_YOY_Quarter__c value)
CustomField.formula: IF(Effective_Date__c >= DATE(YEAR(Board_Report_YOY_Quarter__c)-1, MONTH(Board_Report_YOY_Quarter__c), DAY(Board_Report_YOY_Quarter__c)), TEXT(YEAR(Board_Report_YOY_Quarter__c))+"-"+TEXT(MONTH(Board_Report_YOY_Quarter__c)), IF(Effective_Date__c >= DATE(YEAR(Board_Report_YOY_Quarter__c)-2, MONTH(Board_Report_YOY_Quarter__c), DAY(Board_Report_YOY_Quarter__c)), TEXT(YEAR(Board_Report_YOY_Quarter__c)-1)+"-"+TEXT(MONTH(Board_Report_YOY_Quarter__c)), IF(Effective_Date__c >= DATE(YEAR(Board_Report_YOY_Quarter__c)-3, MONTH(Board_Report_YOY_Quarter__c), DAY(Board_Report_YOY_Quarter__c)), TEXT(YEAR(Board_Report_YOY_Quarter__c)-2)+"-"+TEXT(MONTH(Board_Report_YOY_Quarter__c)), IF(Effective_Date__c >= DATE(YEAR(Board_Report_YOY_Quarter__c)-4, MONTH(Board_Report_YOY_Quarter__c), DAY(Board_Report_YOY_Quarter__c)), TEXT(YEAR(Board_Report_YOY_Quarter__c)-3)+"-"+TEXT(MONTH(Board_Report_YOY_Quarter__c)), TEXT(YEAR(Board_Report_YOY_Quarter__c-4))+"-"+TEXT(MONTH(Board_Report_YOY_Quarter__c))))))
CustomField.label: Grouping - YOY Quarter (BR)
